title: On Our Radar
summary: On Our Radar scans conflicts and crises around the globe every week and features some of the hotspots Crisis Group’s analysts are closely watching. Whether an under-reported trend or a headline-grabbing development, our field experts explain why it matters or what should be done.

ai.sum: International Crisis Group announces its weekly On Our Radar series highlighting global conflict hotspots.

brief.summary: This is a short weekly newsletter from International Crisis Group that scans conflicts and crises around the world and highlights a selection of hotspots its analysts are monitoring. The text itself does not set out a specific argument, factual findings or recommendations; it describes the format of the series. Each entry is meant to explain either why an under-reported trend or a headline development matters, or what should be done about it, but the body provided contains no such content. The piece therefore functions as a programme description rather than an analysis of any particular conflict.
brief.argument: The authors present On Our Radar as a weekly roundup that flags global conflicts and explains why selected developments matter.
